notes.title: Japanese Language Support
notes.notes:
Due to some complex reason, we didn't put Japanese version of the game on steam for a long time.
We are very sorry for that.

But now we have solved that problem.
Japanese version is currently online!


Anyone who have ever bought Japanese Box version from "Yuuhei Satellite" can get a FREE Steam version from http://jp.myacg.cc/

Just Login and you will see your Steam Key there,


We also fix some small bug, typo, etc.

Store pages in Japanese will come later.

Thank you.

notes.title: The Disappearing Of Gensokyo is the first Touhou fangame on Steam
notes.notes:
The Japanese mega-franchise that is Touhou has had a good time on Steam lately, with the latest main game in the series debuting to massive sales and user-reviews to match, and the most recent spinoff fighting game making a splash despite its Japanese-language-only release.

What I wasn’t expecting was for commercial Touhou fangames to make their presence known so soon. Available now on Steam from Chinese indie team MyACG Studio is The Disappearing Of Gensokyo, an action-RPG/twin-stick shooter hybrid starring the iconic cast of the shmup series. And it’s in (patchy) English, too.

(more…)

notes.title: 3.0.2 Update Improvements / Bug Fix
notes.notes:
1. Update Translation. We will keep improving translation. 
2. Fix the bug that sometimes Cirno Yukkuri Mission Item may not drop.
3. Fix the bug that Big Power Only recovers only a little bit bullets (Should be much more.)
4. Fix the bug that changed key will be set to default when a new scene is loaded.
5. Fix the Bug that cannot select 2nd character before level 2-4. (Kokoro boss fight).
6. Improve UI navigation when using Game pad.
7. Fix wrong Game pad instruction text.

Yes, I am the Bug King!
